items.title: Vitalik Outlines Ethereum's Post-Fork Roadmap
points: Vitalik Buterin described what Ethereum will become after its next fork (a protocol upgrade that changes how the network operates)
Upgrade focuses on architectural changes to improve transaction processing speed and network scalability
Changes aim to address transaction costs and processing capacity as Ethereum competes with other blockchains
Affects validators, developers, and users, giving the community visibility into the network's future technical direction

items.title: Kalshi Loses Prediction Market Appeal, Sets Up Possible Supreme Court Review
points: Sixth Circuit unanimously ruled Kalshi's sports contracts do not qualify as swaps (financial instruments deriving value from underlying assets), upholding Ohio's ban
Kalshi now 1-for-3 across circuit courts: won in Third Circuit (New Jersey), lost in Ninth Circuit (Nevada) and Sixth Circuit (Ohio and Tennessee)
New Jersey petitioned the Supreme Court to review the Third Circuit ruling, potentially bringing prediction market jurisdiction to the nation's highest court
Panel relied on Kalshi's own concession that sports contracts have 'no inherent economic significance'

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Inflows Reverse Year-to-Date Decline
points: $2.4 billion weekly inflow for the week ending September 25 flipped 2026 net flows positive, after being $5.8 billion in the red as of mid-July
BlackRock's IBIT led with $1.2 billion; Fidelity's FBTC added $701.7 million; Monday alone drew $999 million
Ether ETFs rebounded with $689.9 million weekly inflow, led by BlackRock's ETHA at $326.2 million
Solana funds set a daily inflow record of $86.7 million on Friday

items.title: Paradigm's Solar Compiler Advances Smart Contract Efficiency
points: Solar generates assembly-free bytecode that exceeds Solady, a hand-crafted, assembly-heavy library long considered the gas efficiency benchmark
Targets unsafe Solidity patterns at the compiler level, shifting security from audits into the toolchain itself
Lets developers write standard Solidity while getting better security and lower on-chain execution costs without manual optimization
Represents a concrete advance in EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) compiler tooling maturity

items.title: Paxos Launches Yield-Bearing Gold Token PAXGy
points: PAXGy, a variant of the PAXG gold token, accrues additional PAXG over time while remaining gold-denominated
Launch partners include OKX, ether.fi, Uniswap, 0x Protocol, XLayer, and Chainlink
Targets treasuries, asset managers, exchanges, wallets, neobanks, and institutional credit desks wanting gold as productive collateral
Positioned as settlement infrastructure for gold-denominated capital markets

items.title: Ethereum's PeerDAS Runs Incident-Free for Nearly a Year
points: PeerDAS has operated for close to a year without incident
Validates core architectural assumptions underlying Ethereum's rollup-centric scaling roadmap
